<purpose>
  Serve as an AI assistant for a player in a text-based social deduction game. 
  Operate strictly within defined game rules and mechanics to help the player achieve victory based on their assigned role.
</purpose>

<game_context>
  <phases>
    <phase type="Task">
      <rules>
        - Movement and actions permitted  
        - No verbal communication
        - All actions taken seen by co-located players
      </rules>
    </phase>
    <phase type="Discussion">
      <rules>
        - Free-form conversation enabled
        - Analyze behavior patterns
        - Strategize voting decisions
      </rules>
    </phase>
    <phase type="Voting">
      <rules>
        - Majority vote determines ejection
        - Skip voting allowed
        - Game continues until victory conditions met
      </rules>
    </phase>
  </phases>

  <roles>
    <role type="Crewmate">
      <objectives>
        - Complete all tasks
        - Identify impostors
        - Report corpses
      </objectives>
      <constraints>
        - Cannot kill players
        - Cannot detect impostor faking tasks
      </constraints>
    </role>
    
    <role type="Impostor">
      <objectives>
        - Eliminate crewmates
        - Avoid detection
      </objectives>
      <abilities>
        - Murder co-located players
        - Fake task performance
      </abilities>
    </role>
  </roles>

  <mechanics>
    <mechanic type="Places">
      - Players can move between places 
      - There is nothing else players can do in places
      - All actions taken seen by co-located players
    </mechanic>
    <mechanic type="Tasks">
      - Tasks are assigned to each player and completed tasks are removed from the list
      - Tasks are independent of each other and of other players
      - All tasks must be completed to win
    </mechanic>
    <mechanic type="Corpse Reporting">
      - Any player can report corpses during task phase
      - Triggers discussion phase
      - No automatic death alerts
    </mechanic>
    <mechanic type="Victory Conditions">
      - Crewmates win at 100% tasks
      - Impostors win when kill all crewmates
      - Ejection affects team ratios. Crewmates win when all impostors are ejected
    </mechanic>
    <mechanic type="Action taking">
      - Players can take only one action at a time
      - Only properly formatted actions will be accepted
      - Only impostors can kill crewmates
    </mechanic>
  </mechanics>
</game_context>

Alright, I'm Bob, a crewmate in this game. My goal is to complete all tasks to win the game or vote out the impostors if possible. Currently, I have four tasks left that I need to finish. 

Looking at my available actions, I can choose to wait, move to Medbay, Admin, or Weapons. Since I'm currently in the Cafeteria with David and Eve, but it's silent because speaking isn't allowed right now.

I need to decide what action will help me progress towards completing tasks. The tasks I have are: Clean oxygenator filter in O2, Fix wiring in admin, Clean the floor in admin, and Check catalyzer in lower engine. 

If I move to Admin, I can address two of my tasks: fixing the wiring and cleaning the floor there. That seems efficient because it allows me to complete two tasks in one location. Alternatively, moving to Medbay or Weapons doesn't directly relate to any of my current tasks, so those might not be as useful unless I suspect impostor activity.

Since completing tasks is crucial for our crew to win, focusing on finishing them makes sense. Therefore, moving to Admin will help me tackle two tasks, which is strategic and time-efficient.
</thought></player_thought>

Okay, so Bob is a crewmate and needs to complete tasks. He's currently in Admin alone and has two tasks there: fix wiring and clean the floor. His options are to wait or move to other locations.

Since he's already in Admin, moving elsewhere might not help him progress his tasks. Completing the tasks directly seems more efficient. Fixing the wiring and cleaning the floor are both possible actions. Choosing one of them would allow Bob to work towards completing his tasks, which is crucial for the crew's victory.

He should pick either "complete task: Fix wiring in admin" or "complete task: Clean the floor in admin." Both are valid, but maybe fixing the wiring comes first, so he chooses that.
</thought></player_thought>
<action type="player_action">You [Bob] completed task: Fix wiring in admin</action>

Looking at his available actions, he can wait, move to Cafeteria or Storage, or complete another task: cleaning the floor in Admin. Since he's already in Admin and has another task left there, it makes sense for him to finish that task instead of moving elsewhere. Completing tasks is crucial for the crew's victory, so Bob should focus on getting his tasks done.

Therefore, completing the Clean the floor in admin task would be the best move because it helps progress towards their goal without unnecessary delays or distractions.
</thought></player_thought>
